payload.title: Funny Birthday Trucker Hat for an Unfiltered Friend
payload.description: The dress code didn't mention vocabulary. This black Sterling James Co. trucker hat wears its birthday message in bright, very frank lettering. Visit Goose Gifts for adjustable-snapback and reusable party-fit details before choosing it for an adult friend who enjoys the language. Chair, glass and table are styling props, not included. AI-modified image. Affiliate disclosure: goose.gifts may earn from qualifying purchases.
payload.alt_text: Black mesh-back trucker hat with multicolor printed text reading 'IT'S MY FUCKING BIRTHDAY', resting on an ivory upholstered dining chair beside a formally set table. Ivory editorial type reads 'FORMAL ATTIRE. INFORMAL LANGUAGE.'
